title: TSD Daily — Sunday, August 16, 2026
summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash lands at half price with a big coding jump, Alibaba open-weights a 27B model that runs on one GPU, a CVSS 10 SAP flaw goes from patch to live exploitation in three days, Hurricane Lala knocks out most of the Big Island's power while Indiana breaks a 1913 flood record, and the money move is turning dependency patching into a paid monthly.
